rootCauses.title: Emulated shadow DOM leaks the composed tree into the light-DOM API, so React/Svelte hydration (and reconciliation) inside upgraded custom elements sees a different tree than the server HTML
rootCauses.area: crates/script/js/20_dom.js (shadow emulation 201-315, preInsert/lightInsert 858-889, replaceChildImpl 907-915, Node getters 1169-1210, Element.children 2453); vendor/blitz-dom (stylo.rs TShadowRoot todo!() at 276-289 and shadow_root()/containing_shadow() = None at 874-880, layout/construct.rs child collection)
rootCauses.mechanism: Shadow DOM is an approximation (crates/script/js/README.md: 'shadow content is rendered as the host's children ... The host's light-DOM getters therefore see the composed tree'). attachShadowImpl (20_dom.js:250-268) gives the ShadowRoot the SAME node id as the host; shadowPrepare (208-217) moves every light child of the host into a detached DocumentFragment (info.lightFrag); the shadow content is then appended to the host itself and shadowDistribute (218-243) moves the light nodes one by one into the matching <slot> element (or leaves them in lightFrag when there is no slot). Consequences for anything that walks the light DOM of an upgraded host: (1) host.childNodes/firstChild/lastChild/children/childElementCount/textContent/innerHTML return the shadow content (<style>, <div class=w><slot>...) instead of the authored light children (Node getters 1169-1210 just call N.firstChild/N.parent on the real tree); (2) a slotted light node has parentNode == <slot> (not the host), previous/nextSibling only see slot-mates; (3) unslotted light children live in the detached lightFrag: isConnected=false, getRootNode() != document, getElementById/querySelector miss them, nested custom elements get no connectedCallback, <style>.sheet is null; (4) host.replaceChild(new, slottedChild) throws NotFoundError (replaceChildImpl 915 has no lightFrag handling, unlike preInsert/removeChildImpl) and ChildNode.before/after on such nodes misbehave; host.insertBefore(new, ref) can throw 'the reference node is not a child of the parent'. React's hydration (tryToClaimNextHydratableInstance: nextHydratableInstance = parent.firstChild/.nextSibling; popHydrationState throws #418 when unclaimed tail nodes remain in a host that should have none) therefore fails with #418 (elements) / 'Expected server HTML to contain a matching text node' whenever a React-managed subtree contains a custom element that already got its shadow root when the root hydrates (module scripts that customElements.define() run before React's MessageChannel-scheduled hydration). Svelte 5 hydrate() walks the same siblings and warns hydration_mismatch, then its client fallback fails with 'Cannot read properties of null (reading before)' (replaceChild/anchor.before on slotted nodes). The failure is a RACE: if hydration commits before the upgrade (fast machine, telekom on Linux today) nothing is reported, if the upgrade wins (CI/Windows, finn.no always) the whole root switches to client rendering (#423), duplicates errors (10x #418 on telekom) and later updates hit NotFoundError. The HTML parser is NOT involved: script-stripped raw HTML of coursera/autoscout24/stern/otto parses to an identical tree in Sharko and Chromium (0 diff lines with a canonical tree walker, noscript with scripting on), and a 23-case (React 18) and 26-case (React 19) SSR->hydrateRoot suite (adjacent text + <!-- -->, tables, inputs, svg, style objects, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, entities, Suspense <!--$-->, useId, template, hoisted title/meta/link/style, forms, picture, ...) hydrates clean in Sharko; only the custom-element-with-shadow case fails.
evidence: React 18 dev harness (h1/page.html, renderToString -> hydrateRoot, my-el defined with attachShadow+<slot> before hydration): Sharko 'Expected server HTML to contain a matching text node for "light text " in <my-el>' + #418 recoverable errors for case Custom; Chromium: no error for that case (the 'Pre' case fails identically in both = React quirk, ignore).

React 19 dev harness (h3/page.html, 26 cases): only case 'Ce' (custom element with shadow root) fails in Sharko, Chromium clean. Svelte 5 harness (svelte/page.html, dynamic children inside <my-el> with shadow+slot): Sharko warns https://svelte.dev/e/hydration_mismatch and rewrites the DOM (comment markers lost), Chromium clean.
Direct API probe (repro1/repro.html): for light text bold after attachShadow: Chromium childNodes=[#text,,#comment], firstChild=#text, textContent 'light text bold'; Sharko childNodes=[

repro5/repro.html: host.replaceChild(new, lightChild) -> Sharko NotFoundError, Chromium ok; host.childNodes after insertBefore shows only the shadow <div>. repro7/repro.html: light <style>/<div> appended to a host without <slot>: Sharko isConnected=false, style.sheet=null, getElementById=null, no connectedCallback for a nested custom element; Chromium all true (matches the 'insertBefore reference node is not a child' NotFoundError on 6 sweep sites and styled-components error #17 'CSSStyleSheet could not be found' = style.sheet null on telekom).

Causal test on the real finn.no (local proxy injproxy.js rewrites the origin HTML: injects a script first in <head> and a <base>): unmodified -> 2x 'Minified React error #418' (react-dom v19 frontpage island and search-newfrontier-podlet); with customElements.define suppressed -> 0 React errors; with Element.prototype.attachShadow returning the shadow root of a detached <div> (host children untouched) -> 0 React errors. So hydration succeeds exactly when the host's light DOM is not disturbed. Log shows attachShadow on w-button/w-badge/w-icon with children=1..2 before hydration.

otto.de (Svelte fti_flyout, ~40 oc-*/nav-* custom elements, 100+ shadow hosts): direct run -> 'Svelte hydration failed, activating fallback TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading Symbol(text))' + 2x hydration_mismatch + 'Cannot read properties of null (reading before)'; same page with attachShadow neutralised -> the fatal fti_flyout error and 1 mismatch disappear (1 warning left, probably from the light-fragment/insert paths or the side effects of the hack). Chromium: none. Result is flaky (a LC_ALL run had 0 warnings), as expected for an upgrade-vs-hydrate race.

telekom.de: the hydrated React root #homepage-f7a3d9 contains 13 Stencil <matrix-asterisk> elements (shadow root, empty light DOM in Chromium) plus 13 <matrix-modal>; the sweep stacks are Xe=tryToClaimNextHydratableInstance / Rk=beginWork(HostComponent) of React 18 (react.2d5c17e5.js:113:103, :284:283) and #423 from the HostRoot. In today's Linux runs (3/3) hydration finishes before Stencil upgrades the hosts, so no #418 (race), but the shape matches: host.childNodes shows shadow children where React expects none.

Sweep-wide symptom of the same mechanism: 'reference node is not a child of the parent' NotFoundError 398x in the Linux sweep logs on finn.no, caniuse.com, flixbus.de, o2online.de, reddit.com, web.dev; sitediff 'dom-differs' on otto.de (115/789 elements matched) and stern.de (57/298, ws-sticky-header) is partly path mismatch caused by slotted nodes being re-parented under <slot>.

repro.path: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sharko-browser/8d979774-b495-516b-a198-458f7b9b0b92/scratchpad/rc/react-hydration/repro1/repro.html (API view), h1/page.html (React 18 SSR hydration), h3/page.html (React 19), svelte/page.html (Svelte 5), repro5/repro.html (mutations), repro7/repro.html (unslotted light children); run: ./runboth.sh repro1/repro.html (prints window.__result for Sharko then Chromium)
repro.expected: Chromium: host.childNodes/firstChild/textContent/innerHTML are the authored light children; light children keep the host as parentNode and stay connected; hydrateRoot over SSR HTML containing an upgraded shadow host reports no mismatch
repro.actual: Sharko: host.childNodes = shadow content (<style>, <div.w>), slotted nodes have <slot> as parent, unslotted light nodes are disconnected, replaceChild throws NotFoundError, React #418 / Svelte hydration_mismatch

sites: telekom.de (plausible, timing dependent, not reproduced today)
rootCauses.estimatedImpact: high — every framework that hydrates or reconciles light DOM inside custom elements with shadow roots (Lit/Stencil/FAST/Shoelace/Ionic/Salesforce/design-system components inside React, Svelte, Vue, Angular pages), plus any script that reads host.children/textContent/innerHTML or inserts next to a slotted node; also skews sitediff element matching (dom-differs) for component-heavy sites (otto, stern, reddit, web.dev)
rootCauses.fixSketch: Target design (L): give shadow roots their own node (a DocumentFragment-like node with its own child list, host.shadow_root = Some(id)) so the real tree = light DOM and every DOM getter/mutator (childNodes, parentNode, siblings, textContent, innerHTML, replaceChild, before/after, isConnected, querySelector) is correct for free; teach blitz-dom the flat tree: a flat_children(node) used by layout construction (layout/construct.rs) and by Stylo's TNode::traversal_children/traversal_parent/shadow_root()/containing_shadow()/assigned_slot (stylo.rs 276-289, 874-880; implement TShadowRoot::host/style_data instead of todo!()), slot -> assigned light nodes (name match, fallback content), composed event path (host <- slot <- shadow root) and hit-testing/focus over the flat tree; keep shadow_css.rs selector prefixing for scoping until Stylo cascade-per-shadow data is wired. Interim (M, mostly JS): (a) replace the detached lightFrag by a connected hidden container inside the host (display:none) so unslotted light children stay connected (fixes isConnected/getElementById/style.sheet/connectedCallback, styled-components #17), (b) keep an ordered per-host light list (info.light) maintained by preInsert/lightInsert/removeChildImpl/replaceChildImpl/replaceAll/normalize and make childNodes/firstChild/lastChild/children/childElementCount/hasChildNodes/textContent/innerHTML/outerHTML of a host, and parentNode/parentElement/previousSibling/nextSibling of light nodes, resolve through it (helper lightView(idOf(w))), (c) add lightFrag handling to replaceChildImpl (915) and to ChildNode.before/after/replaceWith, (d) make Element.querySelector*/getElementsBy* on a host skip shadow content. Add tests: the React 18/19 and Svelte harnesses above as repro pages (SSR HTML pre-generated, assert no console warnings) plus WPT dom/shadow-dom and custom-elements subsets.

rootCauses.title: V8/ICU default locale is the OS locale (en-US) while navigator.language/Accept-Language say de-DE: Date/Number/Intl output without explicit locale differs from Chromium
rootCauses.area: crates/script/src/platform.rs (V8/ICU init, after v8::icu::set_common_data_78 at line 36); single source for the language: crates/common/src/i18n.rs / crates/script/js/40_webapi.js:4530 (navigator.language 'de-DE') and crates/netstack/src/config.rs:70 (Accept-Language)
rootCauses.mechanism: Sharko presents itself as de-DE (navigator.language 'de-DE', languages ['de-DE','de','en-US','en'], Accept-Language de-DE,de;q=0.9,...) but never sets the ICU default locale, so V8's Intl uses the process/OS locale: POSIX on Linux (=> en-US), the Windows user locale on the CI runner. Every call without an explicit locale (Date#toLocaleString/-DateString/-TimeString, Number#toLocaleString, new Intl.NumberFormat()/DateTimeFormat()/RelativeTimeFormat()/ListFormat(), Date#toString time zone name) therefore formats as en-US. A German SSR page that formats server side in de-DE (or a client that formats with the default locale after SSR) yields text mismatches => React #425/#418 (text) and visibly wrong prices/dates. rusty_v8 (v8-152.2.0, src/icu.rs:68) exposes v8::icu::set_default_locale.
evidence: repro3/repro.html: Sharko Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().locale 'en-US' (navigator.language 'de-DE'); (new Date(Date.UTC(2024,0,5,13,4,5))).toLocaleString() '1/5/2024, 1:04:05 PM' vs Chromium '5.1.2024, 13:04:05'; (1234567.891).toLocaleString() '1,234,567.891' vs '1.234.567,891'; Intl.NumberFormat(undefined,{style:'currency',currency:'EUR'}) '€1,234.50' vs '1.234,50 €'; RelativeTimeFormat '1 day ago' vs 'vor 1 Tag'; Date#toString '(Coordinated Universal Time)' vs '(Koordinierte Weltzeit)'.
Mechanism check: running the same page with LC_ALL=de_DE.UTF-8 LANG=de_DE.UTF-8 makes Sharko report de-DE and '1.1.1970, 00:00:00'.

Negative result: with LC_ALL=de_DE the React/Svelte errors on coursera, finn.no and otto.de did NOT disappear, so this is not the cause of the listed errors; it is a real, separate divergence in the same family (client-only Intl differences) that will produce #425-style text mismatches on locale-formatting SSR pages.
rootCauses.estimatedImpact: high — every page using default-locale formatting (toLocaleString(), Intl.* with undefined locale) on German and non-English sites; affects displayed prices/dates and SSR hydration text equality
rootCauses.fixSketch: In platform.rs init Once, right after the ICU data is loaded and before v8::V8::initialize(), call v8::icu::set_default_locale(<language tag>) with the same tag that navigator.language / Accept-Language use (de-DE today; read it from one shared constant in common::i18n so the three stay in sync). V8 caches the default locale per isolate at first use, so it must run before the first isolate/context is created. Add a JS-layer test (Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().locale === navigator.language, (1234.5).toLocaleString() === '1.234,5'). If a per-tab language is ever added, wrap Intl constructors instead.

rootCauses.title: Stylo servo media-feature table has only 14 features: scripting, update, color, display-mode, overflow-block/inline, color-gamut, grid, prefers-reduced-motion/contrast, forced-colors, ... never match (CSS and matchMedia)
rootCauses.area: stylo 0.21 servo/media_features.rs (static MEDIA_FEATURES: [QueryFeatureDescription; 15]) -> vendor/patch it via [patch.crates-io], or adapt in vendor/blitz-dom media handling
rootCauses.mechanism: Stylo compiled for the servo engine flavour knows only width, height, orientation, pointer, any-pointer, hover, any-hover, aspect-ratio, device-width/height, scan, resolution, device-pixel-ratio and prefers-color-scheme. Any other feature parses as unknown and the whole query evaluates false, both in stylesheets and in window.matchMedia (the JS layer evaluates with the same engine). Chromium answers true for (scripting: enabled), (color), (update: fast), (display-mode: browser), (overflow-block: scroll), (overflow-inline: scroll), (min-color-index: 0), (monochrome: 0), (color-gamut: srgb), (grid: 0), (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference), (prefers-contrast: no-preference), (forced-colors: none), (inverted-colors: none), (prefers-reduced-data: no-preference). finn.no ships <style>@media(scripting: enabled){[data-await-elements]{display:none !important}}</style> in its head, which therefore never applies in Sharko (elements meant to be hidden until the await-elements script runs are visible: part of finn.no's 'text-extra'). Hooks such as useMediaQuery('(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)') or `matchMedia('(update: fast)')` also differ between SSR default and client, which feeds effect-time setState.
evidence: repro4/repro.html evaluates 20 features via getComputedStyle and matchMedia: 13 CSS results and 13 matchMedia results differ (all false in Sharko, true in Chromium); hover/pointer/any-hover/min-resolution/video-dynamic-range/prefers-reduced-data agree.
raw finn.no HTML contains the @media(scripting: enabled) rule; Sharko evaluates it false.

repro.expected: Chromium: (scripting: enabled), (color), (update: fast), (display-mode: browser), (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference), ... all match
repro.actual: Sharko: all of them false in @media and matchMedia

sites: finn.no (scripting rule); many sites use prefers-reduced-motion/update/color queries
rootCauses.estimatedImpact: medium — animations gated by (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference), (scripting: enabled)/(update: fast) progressive-enhancement blocks and JS matchMedia-driven state on a large share of modern sites; unproven as a direct cause of any hydration error in this cluster
rootCauses.fixSketch: Vendor stylo (or use [patch.crates-io]) and extend servo/media_features.rs with keyword evaluators for the missing features returning the desktop-headed values (color=8 bits, color-index=0, monochrome=0, color-gamut=srgb(+p3 if wanted), grid=0, update=fast, overflow-block/inline=scroll, scripting=enabled when the page has JS (per-document flag, none for --no-js), display-mode=browser, prefers-reduced-motion/contrast/reduced-data=no-preference, forced-colors=none, inverted-colors=none, dynamic-range=standard); add the small enums to queries/values.rs like Orientation/PrefersColorScheme. Cheaper fallback: rewrite these features to constants in the media text before it reaches Stylo (blitz-dom media parsing + JS matchMedia).

rootCauses.title: sitediff reports React #421 on coursera.org and autoscout24.de as Sharko-only although Chromium logs the identical error; the diff normaliser does not strip Sharko's 'Error: ' prefix
rootCauses.area: tools/sitediff/run.js signature() (line ~322) or probe.js / chrome.js error formatting; crates/browser/src/headless.rs (prints 'Uncaught Error: msg')
rootCauses.mechanism: Sharko's console prints uncaught exceptions as 'Uncaught <Name>: <message>' while Playwright's pageerror handler yields 'Uncaught <message>' (no error name for Error). signature() only strips URLs, hex and digits, so 'Uncaught Error: Minified React error #N...' never equals 'Uncaught Minified React error #N...' and the same error counts as 'only in Sharko' (js-errors issue). The #421 itself is genuine React behaviour in BOTH browsers: a lazily loaded Suspense boundary (coursera: an aria-hidden dialog wrapped in <!--$-->...<!--/$-->) receives a parent re-render before it is hydrated (updateDehydratedSuspenseComponent throws 421 into onRecoverableError), harmless and independent of the engine.
evidence: chromium.json of coursera.org and autoscout24.de contain 'Uncaught Minified React error #421 ...' (coursera also the {"stack":...} console.error variant) with the same bundle offsets (de.app.0f5d45da4588a35e8ae8.js:2:1848386 in updateDehydratedSuspenseComponent).
Live Chromium run of chrome.js https://www.coursera.org/ --console prints both #421 lines; Sharko prints the same two.

Script over tools/sitediff/out: 15 sites where a Sharko 'Uncaught Error: X' has a Chromium 'Uncaught X' twin: bing.com, cloudinary.com, coursera.org, cuny.edu, derstandard.at, dict.cc, dwd.de, faz.net, finn.no (Vitest mocker errors), google.com_search_q_browser, heise.de, lemonde.fr, rottentomatoes.com, temu.com, wetteronline.de.
Parser parity check for the same sites: script-stripped HTML parsed by both engines gives identical trees (0 diff lines for coursera.org, autoscout24.de, stern.de, otto.de).

repro.path: node tools/sitediff/run.js https://www.coursera.org/  (js-errors issue) vs node .../sitediff/chrome.js https://www.coursera.org/ --console 2>&1 | grep 'React error'
repro.expected: no js-errors issue: the error exists in Chromium
repro.actual: js-errors 'Uncaught Error: Minified React error #N' only in Sharko

rootCauses.estimatedImpact: low for users, medium for triage: inflates js-errors on 15 of 195 swept sites and mislabels them as engine bugs
rootCauses.fixSketch: In run.js signature(): first .replace(/^Uncaught (?:\w*Error: )?/, 'Uncaught ') (or make chrome.js/probe.js format pageerror as `${e.name}: ${e.message}`); keep the rest of the normalisation.

notes: Unexplained / caveats. (1) telekom.de: React #418 (10x) and #423 in both sweeps did not reproduce in 3 Linux runs with the rebuilt binary (11:17 build); instead 3 runs show styled-components error #17 from the Hercules chatbot bundle (onebot-webfrontend.oneai.yo-digital.com core-339436f9.js: style.sheet null after insertBefore into the styled-components target) and the chatbot root #__chatBot stays empty. #17 fits the 'unslotted light children live in a detached fragment' defect (root cause 1, style.sheet null) but I could not identify the target element; the style.sheet cases I tried (head, shadow root, iframe, insertBefore(null)) all work. The WAF challenge (aws-waf token) prevents curl/local-proxy replay of telekom, so the hydrate-vs-upgrade race could not be forced there; confidence for telekom is therefore ~0.6. (2) stern.de: no svelte hydration warnings in any current log (Linux sweep, Windows CI, two fresh runs); its sweep issue is dom-differs on <ws-sticky-header> custom elements, consistent with the same shadow emulation but not proven. (3) autoscout24.de: #421 only in the Windows run and also present in Chromium (root cause 4); its 'document.registerElement is not a function' warnings (custom elements v0, as24-tracking/as24-icon) are a separate missing API (Chromium removed it too, so likely harmless in both). (4) otto.de leaves one hydration_mismatch warning even with attachShadow neutralised; possible causes: the hack itself (shadowRoot becomes null for component code), or unrelated timing. (5) Environment: HTML parsing, noscript handling, <!-- --> markers, tbody/foster parenting, text splitting are all identical to Chromium on the swept pages and on the React/Svelte SSR harnesses, so parser work is not needed for this cluster. (6) Environment facts found: Sharko navigator.userAgentData/connection/hardwareConcurrency (8 vs 4)/languages differ trivially and did not matter; other env probe diffs (document.fullscreenEnabled false, readyState 'interactive' at eval time, performance paint entries 0, trustedTypes/scheduler/serviceWorker missing, SharedArrayBuffer present) were checked against the code paths of the failing sites and are not implicated. (7) Race dependence: because the shadow-emulation failure depends on custom-element upgrade order vs React's scheduler, results vary run to run and machine to machine; the h1/h3/svelte harnesses are deterministic (upgrade before hydrate) and should be the regression tests. (8) Tooling left in the scratch dir: injproxy.js (HTML-rewriting proxy for causal experiments), chrome_inj.js (Playwright with --init/--locale), walker.js + cmp.sh (canonical DOM-tree diff Sharko vs Chromium), runboth.sh (prints window.__result from both), envprobe.js.
